kinds.says: Every concept of an external standard this host has met, statused the session it surfaced, with the ONE place it is declared.

statuses.means: the whole of the standard's benefit is taken
taken in part; the note names the missing part
met and not yet taken
deliberately not taken; the note says why
believed taken, not yet measured in code
became a cardinal, a law or a card; the place cites this row back

kinds.says: What was seen beyond a task's scope, triaged so that nothing surfaced is lost.

statuses.means: seen, not yet triaged
it blocks or contaminates the work in hand
carried into a wave already planned; the note names it
registered to be paid later
a decision only the owner makes
fixed; the note names the change
judged not worth acting on; the note says why
became a card or a guard; the place cites this row back

kinds.says: Every architecture this host has committed to, so a vision never evaporates when the team moves on.

statuses.means: raised, not yet designed
a design exists; it is referenced
work on it is in flight
built and green
proven on the real stack
held, by decision; the note says until when
replaced; the note names by what
decided against; the note says why

kinds.says: Questions the doctrine could not answer, declared where they were met instead of improvised around.

statuses.means: met, unanswered
answered; the place that answers it cites this row back
